Tyto nástroje potřebují samostatný balíč: These tools need a separate package for a specific model. Connecting copies or downloads nothing; disconnecting does not delete the original files.
Nastavení i jeho zálohy jsou jen v uživa: Settings and backups stay in user data, outside Git. Each addon is enabled separately and only for compatible models. Enabling does not validate every scientific claim about the method.
